text.en:
Section twenty-one hundred and thirty-four of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven,
known as the Administrative Code, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-seven hundred and forty-eight, is
hereby further amended, to read as follows:
"Section 2134. Exemptions from tolls.-No toll or ferriage authorized by this article shall be collected from (a)
officers or enlisted men of the United States Army or Navy or other employees of the United States
Government in the Philippines; (b) officers or enlisted men of the Constabulary; (c) members of the municipal
police; (d) Insular, provincial or municipal officers on official business; (e) any person traveling on foot or
mounted on an animal, alone or accompanying animals; (f) vehicles engaged primarily in the carrying of mail;
and (g) animal-drawn vehicles."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 20, 1935.
